```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(box.path = here())

box::use(
  r / load
)
box::reload(load)

library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
# library(marginaleffects)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggpubr)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

z_transform <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x))

df <- load$regression_data() |>
  filter(video_datetime_upload > "2020-01-01") |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  mutate(
    views = log(video_views),
    likes = video_likes,
    d_elite = elite,
    elite = elite - mean(elite),
    d_pplcentr = pplcentr,
    pplcentr = pplcentr - mean(pplcentr)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```


# show descriptives

```{r}
df |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    elite_mean = mean(d_elite),
    elite_sd = sd(d_elite),
    pplcentr_mean = mean(d_pplcentr),
    pplcentr_sd = sd(d_pplcentr),
  ) |> print(n=100)
```

# NB Regression on Video Views

```{r}
elite_form <- formula(
  views ~ channel * (elite) + n_sents + released_at
)

elite_model <- lm(elite_form, data = df)
summary(elite_model)
```

```{r}
pplcentr_form <- formula(
  views ~ channel + pplcentr + channel:pplcentr + released_year + channel:released_year + n_sents
)

pplcentr_model <- lm(pplcentr_form, data = df)
summary(pplcentr_model)
```

```{r}

create_plot <- function(model, predictor) {

  grid_vals <- list(
    c(-0.1, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 )
  )
  names(grid_vals) <- predictor
  marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
      model,
      by = c("channel", predictor),
      transform = exp,
      newdata = marginaleffects::datagrid(
        !!!grid_vals,
        grid_type = "counterfactual"
      )
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")
}

elite_plot <- create_plot(elite_model, "elite")
pplcentr_plot <- create_plot(pplcentr_model, "pplcentr")

ggarrange(elite_plot, pplcentr_plot, ncol = 1)
```

# NB Regression on Video Likes

```{r}
elite_form <- formula(
  likes ~ channel + elite + channel:elite + released_year + channel:released_year + video_duration
)

elite_model <- glm.nb(elite_form, data = df)
summary(elite_model)
```

```{r}
pplcentr_form <- formula(
  likes ~ channel + pplcentr + channel:pplcentr + released_year + channel:released_year + video_duration
)

pplcentr_model <- glm.nb(pplcentr_form, data = df)
summary(pplcentr_model)
```

```{r}
elite_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
    elite_model,
    condition = list("channel", "elite" = "quartile")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

pplcentr_plot <- marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
    pplcentr_model,
    condition = list("channel", "pplcentr" = "quartile")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

ggarrange(elite_plot, pplcentr_plot, ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
p <- here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count.svg")
if (file.exists(p)) file.remove(p)
ggsave(p, width = 7, height = 5)
```
